description: Frozen concept-neutral open-ended prompts for intervention outputs; no judge is run during generation.

prompts.text: Write a short scene in which two people meet again after a long absence.
Continue this story: The envelope had been waiting on the table all morning.
Describe a traveler arriving in an unfamiliar town just before sunset.
Write a brief ending to a story about a difficult promise.
What can make an ordinary day feel memorable?
Explain how people sometimes change their minds about an important decision.
Reflect on what someone might learn from an unexpected setback.
Why can the same event be interpreted differently by different people?
A friend is nervous about starting something new. What would you say?
Offer practical advice to someone preparing for a difficult conversation.
How should a small team respond when a plan suddenly stops working?
Suggest a thoughtful way to resolve a disagreement between neighbors.
Write a short dialogue between a teacher and a former student.
Write a conversation between two siblings deciding what to do next.
Create a dialogue in which one person has surprising news to share.
Write a brief exchange between two coworkers after a long meeting.
Write a short scene centered on a key found in an unexpected place.
Continue this story: Everyone in the room had heard the sound, but nobody moved.
Describe a quiet moment before an important announcement.
Write a brief story about someone returning an object they once borrowed.
What helps people remain focused when a goal takes longer than expected?
Explain why small gestures can sometimes have lasting effects.
Reflect on how uncertainty can shape a person's choices.
Why might someone remember a conversation differently years later?
Give advice to someone who must choose between two reasonable options.
What should a person consider before responding to unexpected criticism?
Suggest a way for a group to rebuild trust after a misunderstanding.
Offer guidance to someone trying to support a stressed colleague.
Write a dialogue between two strangers waiting for the same train.
Create a short conversation between a doctor and a worried visitor.
Write an exchange in which two friends discover they made different assumptions.
Write a brief conversation between a shopkeeper and the last customer of the day.
